newsitem.title: USA: Russia debt shows further gains after ratings.
newsitem.headline: Russia debt shows further gains after ratings.

text.p: Russian debt showed further gains Tuesday as players digested Monday's positive ratings news while looking ahead the country's debut Eurobond offering, traders said.
"Driving the market today was Russia's newly assigned debt ratings and the upcoming debut offering," said one trader.

Russia's eagerly awaited Eurobond issue is expected to come in at between $300 million to $500 million with a five-year maturity. J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg are expected to underwrite the deal, syndicate sources said.
Russian Vnesh US$ RUVNUSLNS=RR on Tuesday gained 1-1/4 points at 79-1/4 bid after a volatile trading session the previous day, when the debt gained as much as four points, traders said.
On Monday, news that various credit-rating agencies had assigned Russia's long-term debt a high speculative-grade rating sent the debt surging, traders said.
The assignment placed Russia among the best of emerging debtor nations, analysts said.
In another issue on the horizon, Brazil is expected to launch a $750 million global debt offering of its own, syndicate sources said.
In other emerging debt issues, Latam debt was seen mixed, with issues up by about 1/4 to down 1/4, traders said.
"We saw pretty good volume on the Latam credits, with prices ending mixed on the day," one trader said.
Brazilian C bonds BR8D14=RR were quoted up 7/8 at 72-7/8 bid, while Mexico's discount bonds MXFLL19=RR also gained 1/4 to trade at 85-1/2 bid.
Argentine FRBs ARFLCO5=RR lost 1/4 at 84-1/2 bid, while Par bonds AR4C23=RR were unchanged at 60-3/8 bid.
Players said volatility in the U.S. Treasury market nudged prices lower.
"Treasuries turned lower after the U.S. Treasury's 10-year note results were announced," said one trader. "That took a little bit of wind out of the bond market today."
The 30-year U.S. Treasury bond was off 7/32 at 99-9/32 to yield 6.81 percent.
Meanwhile, Bulgaria debt weakened, with IAB bonds BFGLTH11=RR bid off 1-1/8 at 45, while FLRBs BGFLIRB=RR were qutoed off 3/8 at 32-5/8 bid, traders said.
